original_stop_rule: three consecutive H2-approved rounds with zero new non-redundant English term families and zero new canonical indicator families
reason: The project owner extended the initial twelve-round operational cap to round fifteen and then designated the expanded cap as terminal because further deterministic bootstrap batches had diminishing marginal value.
reporting_requirement: Report this as a retrospective protocol deviation and retain computed round-15 endpoint counts. Do not describe the stopping result as dual-zero unless the adjudicated database counts are in fact both zero.
